notes.sections: A short profile, then experience and education, is the usual order for this country.
notes.max_pages: Two pages, as you asked; one page is more common for early careers.
notes.photo_slot: A photo slot you fill only if you add a photo; photos are uncommon in many workplaces here.
notes.details_shown: Email, phone, location and links are the usual contact details.
notes.date_format: Month and year keeps dates easy to read.
notes.page_size: A4 is the standard paper size here.
